spec.title: Sequencer Client Delay
spec.description: Delay on event processing of a sequencer, compared to the collective

spec.expr: max by(namespace, migration) (label_replace(cometbft_consensus_latest_block_height{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"global-domain-$migration-cometbft-cometbft-rpc"}, "migration", "$1", "job", "global-domain-(\\d)-.*")) - max by(namespace, migration) (label_replace(daml_sequencer_block_height{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"global-domain-$migration-sequencer"}, "migration", "$1", "job", "global-domain-(\\d)-.*"))

max by(namespace, migration) (label_replace(cometbft_consensus_latest_block_height{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"global-domain-$migration-cometbft-cometbft-rpc"}, "migration", "$1", "job", "global-domain-(\\d)-.*")) - max by(namespace, migration) (label_replace(daml_sequencer_block_height{namespace=~"$namespace", job=~"global-domain-$migration-sequencer"}, "migration", "$1", "job", "global-domain-(\\d)-.*"))

spec.title: Sequencer Catchup Speed
spec.description: Catchup speed of the sequencer in the last 5min

spec.title: CantonBFT - Throughput - requests/s
spec.description: Rate of requests ordered and output to the read path.

spec.title: Mediator Client Delay
spec.description: Delay on event processing of a mediator, compared to its corresponding sequencer

spec.title: CantonBFT Block delay
spec.description: Wall-clock time of the ordered block being provided to the sequencer minus BFT time of the block

spec.expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by(namespace, job, node, mode) (rate(daml_sequencer_bftordering_output_block_delay_duration_seconds{namespace=~"$namespace",job=~"global-domain-$migration-sequencer"}[$__rate_interval])))

spec.title: Sequencer core buffer size (blocks #)
spec.description: Size of the buffer in the subscription from the orderer to the sequencer core, in blocks

spec.title: Participant Client Delay
